payload.core_composition_summary: Sort rings by outer radius, then inner radius; then process descending to maintain a feasible tower using a stack.
payload.rationale: Solution first sorts rings using a custom key (outer radius, inner radius), then uses a greedy stack algorithm that depends on the sorted order to construct the optimal tower.
